title: 6 required workspace subdir(s) missing (proposals, patterns, observations, metrics, git/vessels, git/super-repo) → goals
description: 6 required workspace subdir(s) missing (proposals, patterns, observations, metrics, git/vessels, git/super-repo) → goals that fs_write to them fail with ENOENT/EACCES until created (an fs_write that does not mkdir -p its parent is the usual trigger). Lower-severity than a root fault: only that class of goal fails.
